base: Same T1 fixed-root SDF scene, CPU PhysX, timestep.004s, original geometry/mass/drive/friction/velocity. No external cap force, no q/qvel writes. Public layer frozen.

observations: Native q/qvel, raw q/.0004 and original signal, actual shaft angle, click qf and drive policy; total incoming joint-frame wrench on click child and both tilt joints; both coordinate-space limit distances; compare loaded residual against zero-force angle hold.
interpretation: A matching zero-force residual proves cap pushing is not necessary. K-only contrast tests fixture stiffness effect but is not a production fix; actual angle must be compared. Distance-off contrast isolates cone involvement. qf and upper-stop interventions test preload/limit influence, not authorize parameter adoption. Incoming joint wrench is mixed transmitted force, not isolated drive torque. Only with a confirmed fixture cause may repair and rerun acceptance; model-caused response requires proposal.
stop: Complete registered diagnostic batch then stop if no uniquely supported fixture repair. No parameter search; no production/public parameter changes.
